primitives.name: Snap-Back Mechanism
primitives.verbatim_quote: The snap-back rolls the ball back with his hand; the quarter seizes it and passes it to any man for whom the ball is destined in the plan of the play.

primitives.assumptions: Ball motion is governed by deterministic kinematics; snap-back is instantaneous.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When v_sb exceeds threshold, loss of control occurs.

It is mathematically modeled as a kinematic event where the ball's velocity vector changes direction under deterministic constraints. The quarterback’s role is then encoded as a conditional probability function over possible receivers, forming a stochastic process. This duality between mechanical motion and probabilistic decision-making creates a dual structure: one physical (kinematics), one cognitive (decision theory). Failure modes include loss of ball control during snap-back or misalignment in pass coordination.
